images.filename: Goddess of Myrtos, Phournou Koryphi, 2500-2300 BC, AM Ag. Nikolaos, 0501222.jpg
images.caption: Goddess of Myrtos. Rhyton in the shape of a female figure, painted terracotta. Finding at Early Minoan II settlement on top Phournou Koryphi at Myrtos, 2500-2300 BC. Originally stood at the altar inside the oldest known home shrine of the of Minoan Crete. It has a bell-shaped body, without legs, a long neck and small head. Holding a pitcher. Geometric painting of clothing and of sensitive sites. Archaeological Museum of Agios Nikolaos.
images.alt: Goddess of Myrtos. Rhyton in the shape of a female figure, painted terracotta. Finding at Early Minoan II settlement on top Phournou Koryphi at Myrtos, 2500-2300 BC.
